name: LACMED
recent: LAC Med 于2026年11月获得一份价值 RM28.1 million 的诊断影像解决方案合约，使其订单簿增至 RM288.1 million。公司于2026年8月发布了截至2026年6月30日的季度业绩，营收和净利均环比大幅增长。此外，公司近期更换了公司秘书并更新了注册地址。
notable: 获得价值 RM28.1 million 的诊断影像解决方案合约，订单簿增至 RM288.1 million。

recent_en: LAC Med secured a RM28.1 million diagnostic imaging solutions contract in November 2026, lifting its order book to RM288.1 million. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 in August 2026, with revenue and net profit rising sharply quarter-on-quarter. It also changed company secretaries and updated its registered address recently.
notable_en: Secured a RM28.1 million diagnostic imaging solutions contract, raising order book to RM288.1 million.
Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 55.3% QoQ and net profit jumped 410.9% QoQ.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM45.599 million, up 55.3% QoQ; net profit was RM5.267 million, up 410.9% QoQ; net margin improved from 3.5% to 11.6%.
